scenes.title: Make Equal Groups
scenes.narration: Let's start with equal groups. Here are 3 groups. Each group has 4 apples. Every group has the same number.
scenes.visual_description: Three clearly separated groups/baskets with four apples in each; groups appear one after another.

check.question: How many apples are in each equal group?

scenes.title: Repeated Addition
scenes.narration: We can count all the apples by adding 4 three times. 4 plus 4 plus 4 equals 12.
scenes.visual_description: Keep the three groups visible, highlight each group in sequence, and build 4 + 4 + 4 = 12.

scenes.title: Turn It Into Multiplication
scenes.narration: Three equal groups of four can be written as 3 times 4. So 3 times 4 equals 12.
scenes.visual_description: Transition from 4 + 4 + 4 = 12 to reveal 3 × 4 = 12, labelled 3 groups and 4 in each group.

check.question: What is 3 times 4?
check.hint: Three groups of four make twelve.

scenes.title: Share Equally
scenes.narration: Now we have 12 apples and share them equally into 3 groups. Each group gets 4 apples. That's division: 12 divided by 3 equals 4.
scenes.visual_description: Begin with 12 apples together, distribute them into three groups, and reveal 12 ÷ 3 = 4.

check.question: If 12 apples are shared into 3 groups, how many in each?
check.hint: Twelve shared into three equal groups gives four each.

scenes.title: They Work Together
scenes.narration: Multiplication and division are connected. If 3 times 4 equals 12, then 12 divided by 3 equals 4. Nice work! You're ready for a quick quiz.
scenes.visual_description: Show 3 × 4 = 12 and 12 ÷ 3 = 4 side by side with a connecting arrow and a clear transition to the quiz.

check.question: If 3 times 4 is 12, what is 12 divided by 3?
check.hint: Multiplication and division undo each other: four.
